column3: Confirms the exact lower and upper count bounds with all eligible requests retained in the denominator
Prevents candidate requests from silently disappearing between screening and eligibility
Rejects an incomplete or overlapping cohort outcome partition
Prevents known nonacceptance outcomes from being omitted or double-counted
Stops pending decisions from being counted a second time
Keeps known late/disputed cases out of the uncertainty upper bound
No partial aggregate is emitted for a structurally invalid report
Empty eligible cohorts do not become a zero-percent outcome claim
Rejects URL/free-form reference fields in the public aggregate input
Rejects future or unknown schema versions
Detects u64 overflow rather than allowing wrapped totals
Extra result fields cannot bypass versioned schema semantics
Binds input report bytes to a deterministic SHA-256 digest
Maintains explicit limits on what report arithmetic proves
